tools.name: gpsinsight_list_vehicles
tools.description: List the vehicles on the account with their ids, VINs and labels. Use details=1 for all columns, or a comma list such as make,model,odometer. Good first call to find a vehicle. GET /v2/vehicle/list.

tools.name: gpsinsight_read_vehicle
tools.description: Read the record of one vehicle: id, VIN, label and serial number. GET /v2/vehicle/read.

tools.name: gpsinsight_vehicle_location
tools.description: Get the latest position of one vehicle: address, landmark, speed, heading, ignition, odometer, driver and inputs. GET /v2/vehicle/location.

tools.name: gpsinsight_vehicle_history
tools.description: Get the recorded positions of one vehicle between two times, with speed, ignition and odometer. GET /v2/vehicle/history.

tools.name: gpsinsight_vehicle_idle_detail
tools.description: List the idle periods of one vehicle on one day, with place, duration and fuel used while idling. GET /v2/vehicle/idledetail.

tools.name: gpsinsight_vehicle_dtc
tools.description: List the diagnostic trouble codes (DTC) one vehicle reported on one day, with counts and times. GET /v2/vehicle/dtc.

tools.name: gpsinsight_vehicle_scorecard
tools.description: Get the driving score of one vehicle for a period, with daily scores and the events behind them. GET /v2/vehicle/scorecard.

tools.name: gpsinsight_vehicle_fuel_card_transactions
tools.description: List the fuel card transactions of one vehicle between two days. GET /v2/vehicle/fuelCardTransactions.

tools.name: gpsinsight_list_vehicle_groups
tools.description: List the vehicle groups with their ids and vehicle counts. GET /v2/vehiclegroup/list.

tools.name: gpsinsight_list_drivers
tools.description: List the drivers on the account with their ids and contact fields. GET /v2/driver/list.

tools.name: gpsinsight_list_users
tools.description: List the portal users on the account with their usernames and names. GET /v2/user/list.

tools.name: gpsinsight_list_landmarks
tools.description: List the landmarks (named places with a radius or polygon), optionally one landmark group. GET /v2/landmark/list.

tools.name: gpsinsight_list_alerts
tools.description: List the alert types configured on the account and whether each one is active. GET /v2/alert/list.

tools.name: gpsinsight_alert_history
tools.description: List alert events, for one vehicle or one alert id, from the last alert_minutes_age minutes. GET /v2/alert/history.

tools.name: gpsinsight_reverse_geocode
tools.description: Turn a latitude and longitude into a street address and city. GET /v2/geocode/reverse.
